note: Positive tests use isolated temporary authority stores and databases to prove implementation correctness of durable CSV import authority registration, HMAC signing, candidate/region/row binding, restart persistence, and monotonic revocation. They do NOT claim live official Google Trends export availability.

cases.description: Registers a durable signed official CSV authority record and verifies hash, row, keyword, region, and candidate binding
Evaluates a 12-week (>=60 calendar days) US CSV series with valid durable authority as HISTORICAL_SOURCE_VERIFIED and VERIFIED
Persists ingested CSV demand rows to isolated SQLite DB and verifies round-trip readback with durable authority
Survives simulated process restart by reloading durable authority registry from disk
Monotonically revokes a previously valid durable authority record and immediately demotes all dependent observations to UNVERIFIED_SOURCE
Permits ENGINEERING scope evaluation for parser/cadence unit testing when allowEngineeringFixtureLineage=true while blocking BUSINESS scope
